Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

IS: 4769 -1968 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR TROLLEY, DRESSING 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Insti- 
tution on 27 September 1968, after the draft finalized by the Hospital 
Equipment Sectional Committee had been approved by the Consumer 
Products Division Council. 

0.2 The formulation of Indian Standards on hospital equipment haj 
been taken up at the instance of the Advisory Committee for Develop- 
ment of surgical Instruments, Equipment and Appliances, Goverment 
of India. 

0.3 This standard forms one of a series of Indian Standards on hospital 
furniture. Other standards in the series are: 

IS : 4033-1968 General requirements for hospital furniture 
IS : 4034-1968 Castors for hospital equipment 
IS : 4035-1967 Trolleys, stretcher 
IS : 4036-1967 Trolleys, patient 
IS : 4037-1967 Stretcher and Stretcher carriers 
IS : 4266-1967 Lockers, bedside for hospital use 
IS : 4267-1967 Stands, wash hand basin 
IS : 4455-1967 Trolleys, soiled linen 
IS : 4458-1967 Screens, bedside 
IS: 4494-1968 Tables, overbed 
IS : 4787-1968 Table, examination 
0.4 IS : 4033-1968* is a necessary adjunct to this standard. 

0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of 
this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, 
expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with 
IS :2-l960f. The number of significant places retained in the rounded 
off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this 
standard. 



•General requirements for hospital furniture. 
fRuies for rounding off numerical values ( revised ). 



IS : 4769 - 1968 

1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard specifies requirements of dressing trolleys used in 
hospitals and other similar institutions. 

2. TERMINOLOGY 

2.0 For the purpose this standard, the definition given in 2.1 shall apply. 

2.1 Trolley Dressing — Trolley used for the purpose of dressing at the 
bedside in the wards or dressing rooms. 

3. MATERIALS 

3.1 Framework — shall be as given in 2.1 of IS : 4033-1968*. 

3.2 Shelf es — These shall be made from polished plate glass having a 
minimum thickness of 6 mm. 

3.3 Pifot Bar, Rings and Disc — These shall be of mild steel, either of 
cold-rolled or hot-rolled quality. 

3.4 Castors — These shall conform to the requirements specified in 
IS: 4034-1 968f. 

4. DIMENSIONS 

4.1 The main dimensions of the trolley shall be as given in Fig. 1. 

4.2 The thickness of the tubes used and their corresponding outside dia- 
meters lor different parts shall be as given below: 



Member 


Thickness of Tube 
mm 


Outside Dia of Tube

5. MANUFACTURE 

5.1 Framework — The trolley shall have a framework of single conti- 
nuous length mild steel tubes as shown in Fig. 1. The four upright 
members shall be connected together by a pair of longitudinal ana a 
pair of transverse tie rods. The two longitudinal and two transverse 
tie rods shall be connected to the four upright members in such a way 
so as to form supporting frame for shelves, suitable for receiving round- 
edged plate glass shelves. The top shelf shall be provided with a chro- 
mium-plated railing on three sides. On the front side, revolving brackets 

♦General requirement! for hospital farnitare. 
fSpeoi&cation for oaitors for hospital equipment. 



IS : 4769 - 1968

shall be provided for accommodating a 200 mm top dia wash bowl ( see 
IS : 3994-1967* ) and a 200 x ISO x 50 mm size instruments tray I see 
IS : 3993-1967t ). On the left side an attachment shall be provided for 
receiving a waste pail as shown in the Fig. 1. The rest of the details 
shall conform to the requirements laid down in 4 of IS : 4033-19681. 

S.2 Castors — The trolley shall be provided with four castors, each 
50 mm in dia, having antistatic rubber tread. Rest of the details shall 
be as in 4.2 of IS : 4033-1968*. 

6. FINISH 

6.1 The finish shall be as specified in 5 of IS : 4033-1968J. 

6.2 The railing shall be chromium plated over nickel and the plating 
shall conform to Grade B of IS : 1068-1958§. 

7. TESTS 

7.1 Adhesion Test — This shall be conducted as in 6.1.1 of IS : 4033- 
1968$. 

7*2 Performance Teat — This shall be as specified in 6.1.2 of IS : 4033- 
1968$. , However, the performance shall be determined without put- 
ting any additional load; the rest of the things being in position. 

7.2.1 In addition, white taking the performance the glass shelves 
shall not get displaced or make excessive rattling noise. 

8. MARKING 

8.1 The marking shall be as specified in 7 of IS : 4033- 1968$. 

9. PACKING 

9.1 The packing shall be as specified in 8 of IS : 4033-1968$.
